findings.issue: Bear, base and bull values change only the P/E multiple while holding a single broker EPS constant; the required operating-driver-to-EPS scenario bridge is absent, so the formal targets and probabilities are not economically stress-tested.
findings.evidence: 002497 applies CNY2.63 EPS to all 5x/10x/16x cases even though realized lithium ASP, inventory/hedge effects, self-supply and cash conversion are the stated risks. 002812 applies the broker's CNY5.16 2027E EPS to all 6x/13x/20x cases even though its invalidation threshold is EPS below CNY4.0. growth_driver_model records one consolidated EPS per name, leaves opex embedded in the broker forecast, and contains no numeric bear/base/bull unit, ASP, margin, net-profit or EPS assumptions. value_chain_economics separately marks 002812 blocks_valuation: true because the bull inputs are concentrated in one broker model. The model therefore discounts uncertainty mainly through judgmental probabilities and multiples rather than through the earnings denominator that the risks directly affect.
findings.fix_required: Build numeric bear/base/bull operating bridges for each positive-weight name from units/shipments, ASP or unit profit, gross margin, opex/tax, net profit and EPS. For 002497, separate civil-explosives floor economics from lithium-cycle earnings and explicitly remove inventory/hedge one-offs. For 002812, vary 2027E EPS with price, utilization, yield/order and cash evidence; until the blocks_valuation gate is cleared, publish a watchlist sensitivity range rather than a formal positive-weight point target. Recalculate probabilities, anchors, targets and actions after the denominator repair.
